# CloudVerse

> CloudVerse is the Compute Economics Platform for the AI Era. Cloud, AI, data, and engineering spend governed in one place.

## About
CloudVerse gives enterprises economic control over AI, cloud, and data infrastructure across every major provider: AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, Databricks, OpenAI, Anthropic, CoreWeave, and more. Four modules (FinOps Platform, CloudVerse Agentry, CloudVerse Torb, and DataX) share one control plane.

## Proof
- Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices: $738,983 in annualised savings (2026)
- Torb caught +$2.4k–$2.9k/mo in cost impact from a single PR
- DataX detected a $117.16 full scan across 334.6 GB on BigQuery
